steps.text: The operative instruction definitely requires borrowing four processor units from the pool. This quantity is not a draft or alternative. It requires no storage units.
Return four processor units to the pool. This is the job's definite final instruction, without any storage-unit operation.
Borrow one storage unit from the pool. No processor units are requested, and the storage unit will be returned in the following step.
Return the single storage unit to the pool. The job ends with no units held.
